## added-bare

A member linked ABS (Acme Backend) with no repository: your tools now read its tasks, pull requests and findings, and none of its code is checked out. A member ticks its repositories in the session's Link dialog to check one out.

## added-with-repositories

A member linked ABS (Acme Backend) with repositories: your tools now read it, and dude tells you where each repository is checked out once it is cloned.

## removed

A member unlinked BIL (Billing): your tools now refuse it. A checkout of it you hold stays until this session's next fresh agent; do not rely on it.

## repository-removed

A member unlinked the repository ABS/web; ABS stays linked. A checkout of it you hold stays until this session's next fresh agent; do not rely on it.

## all

A member linked ABS (Acme Backend) with no repository: your tools now read its tasks, pull requests and findings, and none of its code is checked out. A member ticks its repositories in the session's Link dialog to check one out.
A member linked SDK (Client SDK) with repositories: your tools now read it, and dude tells you where each repository is checked out once it is cloned.
A member unlinked BIL (Billing): your tools now refuse it. A checkout of it you hold stays until this session's next fresh agent; do not rely on it.
A member unlinked the repository OPS/infra; OPS stays linked. A checkout of it you hold stays until this session's next fresh agent; do not rely on it.
